cms.detail: Wheelchair ordered for mobility, satisfying the device_needed sub-criterion under Prong 1.
No documentation of normal inability to leave home or considerable and taxing effort was found in the encounter.

cms.detail: Homebound documentation is present but not clinically sufficient — Prong 2 effort standard is entirely absent.

reasoning.summary: A wheelchair order satisfies Prong 1 (device_needed), but the encounter contains no documentation of normal inability to leave home or considerable and taxing effort, leaving Prong 2 unmet.

sources.description: Prong 1 — wheelchair order establishing assistive device need
